text:
incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-route spike detected (qps x8 baseline), 5xxs rising to 2.4% and tail latency > 1.2s. Paging on-call (@alyssa).
alyssa: on it, grabbing context. Which tenant slices impacted? any customer-facing 500s?
mike: looks concentrated on /embeddings/v1/batch from regions us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Top callers are two high-throughput jobs (internal) + a 3rd-party partner.
tariq: confirming partner is heavy, but biggest hit from a new batch uploader started ~10m ago. Reranks/chat unaffected so far.
alyssa: ok. priority: preserve chat SLA for interactive routes, keep control-plane healthy. Plan: 1) throttle embeddings per-endpoint QPS for public tenants, 2) apply tighter route-specific limits on the problematic route group, 3) temporarily demote/disable non-critical partners for embeddings.
eng-runtime: recommend the following actions we can push now from control plane: reduce embeddings global QPS per-endpoint from 120 -> 30 (burst 60), set route weight to 0.5 on /embeddings/v1/batch for anonymous orgs, and turn off rerank fallback for that route.
sre-shift: +1 to that. Also we should enable prefix KV cache bypass for that route to avoid extra mem pressure.
alyssa: @eng-runtime, can you run the control-plane change? Please post commands you will run for audit.
eng-runtime: running now. curl to admin API (sanitized):
```
# reduce per-endpoint qps for embeddings route
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/route/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/embeddings/v1/batch","limits":{"qps":30,"burst":60},"scope":"public"}'

# set route weight (regional) for us-east-1
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/api/routing/weights \
  -d '{"route":"/embeddings/v1/batch","region":"us-east-1","weight":0.5}'
```
eng-runtime: change applied to public scope in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Monitoring.
incident-bot: Config change recorded: change_id=chg-20260317-8372, applied_by=eng-runtime.
mike: seeing immediate QPS drop on embeddings in dashboards. 5xx rate trending down to 0.8% after ~90s.
tariq: partner job still spiky, but their tokens are now returning 429s (expected). Reached out to partner via support channel to notify.
cust-success: pinged partner + offered guidance to retry with backoff. They acknowledged.
alyssa: nice. Next: do we need to disable rerank globally for anyone? It isn't necessary yet; rerank traffic is small.
eng-runtime: suggest a secondary mitigation if partner persists: temporarily restrict embeddings per-org concurrent batches to 2 and throttle long-running jobs.
sre-shift: agree. Also adding a graceful fallback: map partner's org-id to lower-priority queue so their requests are metered without impacting chat.
alyssa: handoff to @mike for the next 4h. I'll stay on standby for escalation. Mike, please coordinate with support and track customer impact.
mike: taking oncall. I'll keep track of change_id=chg-20260317-8372 and will rollback when metrics stabilize (5xx < 0.2% and p95 latency < 300ms for 10m).
eng-runtime: will set an automatic rollback job in 60m unless SRE marks hold. Created a watch: prom alert embedding_spike_resolved if 5xx<0.2% && p95<300ms for 10m.
alyssa: note for post-incident: technical action items — build per-route token-bucket that can be adjusted without a full control-plane deploy, and add partner onboarding quota caps.
tariq: logging customer-visible message template in #support-templates.
incident-bot: @mike assigned. Incident status: mitigated -> partial (embeddings throttled). Impact: embeddings degraded for some partners, chat unaffected. Pager cleared.
mike: ack. Will update ops timeline and close thread once metrics stable. :white_check_mark:
